blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Patience and faith fueled Eya Laure to lead Choco Mucho back to the semifinals of the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series. Laure continued to play in situational rotation but made it count with every opportunity, drilling the telling blows to help Choco Mucho oust PLDT, 25-22, 25-23, 18-25, 25-23, and complete the semifinals cast on Thursday night at Mall of Asia Arena. Her first stint with the Flying Titans ended in disappointment after a play-in exit last March, but Laure never wavered in her belief in the team. “Why wouldn’t I believe in this team when our […]...
